items.title: Bland opens research preview of Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model
items.summary: Bland AI's Tofu-1 processes audio directly rather than transcribing to text first, so it can listen and talk at the same time. The gated preview targets noisy, high-stakes phone calls — separating a caller's voice from background noise like traffic, a crying child, or a TV — and is currently limited to select banking, healthcare, insurance, and government customers. Bland hasn't published benchmarks, model size, or pricing yet.
items.whyItMatters: A speech-to-speech model built specifically to stay robust in noisy, real-world audio and handle full-duplex interruptions is a useful data point for Anna/Romain's own noise-handling and barge-in behavior, even without public benchmarks yet to compare against OpenAI Realtime or ElevenLabs.
